01 / SOURCE DOCUMENTBROWSER ONLY

Text stays in this tab and is cleared on reload. Maximum 20 KB. PDF parsing and live LLM generation are not configured.

02 / RETRIEVAL EXPLORER↗

Your documents,
made inspectable.

How this demo works

The text is split into paragraphs. Your question is matched to those paragraphs using shared words and simple synonym expansion. The highest matching passages are quoted with paragraph numbers. This is lexical retrieval, without embeddings or an LLM. It demonstrates evidence inspection, not a full RAG backend.

04 / HOW WE WORK

Clarity at
every step.

Small milestones.
Visible progress.
No mystery handover.

  1. 01

    Understand the friction.

    Map the task, the people using it, and the constraints. Agree what a useful result looks like.

  2. 02

    Build the smallest useful version.

    Turn the scope into a working prototype. Review the interface and data flow before adding complexity.

  3. 03

    Test it against the real task.

    Check expected inputs, failure cases and edge cases. Document limitations and refine together.

  4. 04

    Hand it over properly.

    Source code, setup notes, configuration guidance and a walkthrough so you can keep moving.
